summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Winmark Corporation reporting its second-quarter results and a declared quarterly cash dividend of $1.02 per share. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spinoff, restructuring, or other corporate event. The filing merely updates financial performance and standard dividend policy, both of which are ordinary course items. Therefore, no special-situation classification applies.
